about: A person asks a chat host for two reels about pricing from an episode they drop into the chat. The person speaks outcomes only; the host runs every ren verb, reading the ren-co-editor skill's intent table. tests/scenarios/test_carefree_transcript.py replays the host's commands on test doubles.

attachments.footage: the folder holding the episode, dropped into the chat

turns.person: Can you make two short reels about pricing from this episode?

turns.says: I found two moments about pricing. 1: why pricing scared the guest, and how they finally raised it. 2: the advice to charge more than feels comfortable. Keep both?

turns.person: Hang on before you go any further, I want to run these past the client first.

turns.says: Paused. Nothing more runs until you tell me to carry on.

turns.person: The client is happy, carry on.

turns.says: Two reels about pricing are approved and ready to cut. Say the word and I will build them so you can watch.
